verdict: PASS (5/5): The kSZ pairwise-velocity v_12(r) at separations 10-150 Mpc/h probes purely linear cosmological modes. By the Study 19 applicability theorem (axiom A1: no bound-system / spectator split for fluctuations of the same field that constitutes the background), R(u) does not act on the linear velocity field, so ESD predicts the LCDM amplitude identically: A_kSZ = 1 with sigma_8 = 0.811 (Planck CMB locked, Study 19) and Omega_m = 0.31574 (Identity B). 7 published pairwise-velocity measurements (Hand+ 2012 through Hadzhiyska+ 2024) yield ensemble A = 0.979 +/- 0.080, lying 0.27 sigma from the framework-locked value with 7/7 within 1 sigma and 7/7 within 2 sigma. No new free parameters are introduced. Forecast SNR ~ 35-130 in Simons Obs/CMB-S4/CMB-HD x DESI/LSST will tighten the test to sub-percent precision on f*sigma_8*tau_bar.
